verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Anytime Mailbox supports multiple virtual addresses across markets/states and that capabilities like check deposit vary by location, implying a broad network with differing services, but there's no direct evidence of a searchable location directory or comparison tool showing each location's capabilities before signup. missing for 10: an explicit location-browsing/search page, per-location feature listings (pricing, scanning, mail types), and international location coverage confirmation.
